name: TESSA Marketing & Technology
description: Full-service digital marketing, web development, and AI agent readiness firm (McLean, VA, est. 2012). Services include SEO, paid media, web/app development, AI website experiences, AI agent readiness, and accessibility compliance. Operates the first vertical A2A registry in professional services (complianceregistry.net).

skills.name: TESSA Services Catalog
skills.description: Returns TESSA's full service catalog: SEO, paid media, web/app development, AI website experiences, AI agent readiness, accessibility, and more. Includes pricing tiers and ideal client profiles per service.

skills.name: TESSA Case Studies
skills.description: Returns TESSA's project portfolio with industries, services used, and measurable outcomes. Includes SCS Engineers (240% traffic growth), Network for Good (357K monthly traffic), Gettysburg Museum (193% revenue YoY).

skills.name: AI Agent Readiness Assessment
skills.description: Given a website URL, returns a structured score (0-100) of how ready that site is to be discovered and queried by AI agents. Checks JSON-LD/schema coverage, well-known agent card, llms.txt, robots.txt AI directives, and metadata quality.

skills.name: Find a Professional Services Firm
skills.description: Search the TESSA Professional Services Directory across all vertical registries TESSA operates. Filter by industry, region, or capability. Returns matching firms with their slugs, websites, and locations.

skills.name: Get TESSA's WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility Audit Offering
skills.description: Returns TESSA's WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audit offering in structured form: scope, deliverables (VPAT/ACR, findings report, remediation roadmap), typical timeline, pricing bands (hourly $150–$225, project range $5K–$25K), and the URL of TESSA's accessibility profile in the TESSA Compliance Registry.

skills.name: Book a Strategy Session with TESSA
skills.description: Book a 30-minute strategy session with Kevin Callen on TESSA's calendar. Provide prospect contact info, project brief, and (optionally) a preferred window. TESSA's MCP server finds an open slot, creates a Google Calendar event with a Google Meet link, and sends the prospect the invite. Returns the scheduled time and Meet link to the calling agent.

skills.name: Request an Introduction
skills.description: Request an informational introduction to TESSA, or pass target_firm_slug to request an intro to any firm in the TESSA Professional Services Directory. TESSA logs the lead and forwards a warm intro email to the firm. Use request-strategy-session if you want to actually book a meeting with TESSA.

skills.name: Claim a Directory Listing
skills.description: Record a firm's intent to claim its directory listing in any TESSA-operated registry. Pre-OAuth this is a stub: TESSA logs the claim and a representative reaches out to the supplied email within one business day to verify the claimant. Self-service OAuth-2.1 claim flow lands in a follow-up plan.

skills.name: Request a Quote from a Directory Firm
skills.description: Request a quote from any firm in a TESSA-operated registry. Lighter-weight than request-introduction — explicitly framed as a budget + scope inquiry. Records the request to directory_leads and forwards a structured email to the firm with the prospect's reply-to address.
